verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֔ן וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֵלָ֑יו בְּהַעֲלֹֽתְךָ֙ אֶת־ הַנֵּרֹ֔ת אֶל־ שִׁבְעַ֥ת הַנֵּרֽוֹת׃ יָאִ֖ירוּ מוּל֙ פְּנֵ֣י הַמְּנוֹרָ֔ה
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- ’a·hă·rōn wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ê·lāw bə·ha·‘ă·lō·ṯə·ḵā ’eṯ- han·nê·rōṯ ’el- šiḇ·‘aṯ han·nê·rō·wṯ yā·’î·rū mūl pə·nê ham·mə·nō·w·rāh
verses.literal: Speak to Aaron and tell him When you set up - - - the seven lamps they are to light [the area] in front . . . of the lampstand

verses.original: אַהֲרֹ֔ן וַיַּ֤עַשׂ כֵּן֙ הֶעֱלָ֖ה נֵרֹתֶ֑יהָ פְּנֵ֣י אֶל־ מוּל֙ הַמְּנוֹרָ֔ה כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֛ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ צִוָּ֥ה מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·hă·rōn way·ya·‘aś kên he·‘ĕ·lāh nê·rō·ṯe·hā pə·nê ’el- mūl ham·mə·nō·w·rāh ka·’ă·šer Yah·weh ’eṯ- ṣiw·wāh mō·šeh
verses.literal: And Aaron did so he set up the lamps facing toward the front of the lampstand just as the LORD - had commanded Moses

verses.original: וְזֶ֨ה הַמְּנֹרָה֙ מַעֲשֵׂ֤ה מִקְשָׁ֣ה זָהָ֔ב עַד־ יְרֵכָ֥הּ עַד־ פִּרְחָ֖הּ הַמְּנֹרָֽה׃פ עָשָׂ֖ה אֶת־ מִקְשָׁ֣ה הִ֑וא כַּמַּרְאֶ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ הֶרְאָ֤ה מֹשֶׁ֔ה כֵּ֥ן
verses.transliteration: wə·zeh ham·mə·nō·rāh ma·‘ă·śêh miq·šāh zā·hāḇ ‘aḏ- yə·rê·ḵāh ‘aḏ- pir·ḥāh ham·mə·nō·rāh ‘ā·śāh ’eṯ- miq·šāh hî kam·mar·’eh ’ă·šer Yah·weh ’eṯ- her·’āh mō·šeh kên
verses.literal: This is how the lampstand was constructed it was made of hammered gold from its base to its blossoms - fashioned - - - according to the pattern - the LORD - had shown Moses . . .

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Again the LORD spoke to Moses saying

verses.original: קַ֚ח אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם מִתּ֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְטִהַרְתָּ֖ אֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: qaḥ ’eṯ- hal·wî·yim mit·tō·wḵ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·ṭi·har·tā ’ō·ṯām
verses.literal: Take - the Levites from among the Israelites . . . and make them ceremonially clean -

verses.original: וְכֹֽה־ תַעֲשֶׂ֤ה לָהֶם֙ לְטַֽהֲרָ֔ם הַזֵּ֥ה עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מֵ֣י חַטָּ֑את וְהֶעֱבִ֤ירוּ תַ֙עַר֙ עַל־ כָּל־ בְּשָׂרָ֔ם וְכִבְּס֥וּ בִגְדֵיהֶ֖ם וְהִטֶּהָֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōh- ṯa·‘ă·śeh lā·hem lə·ṭa·hă·rām haz·zêh ‘ă·lê·hem mê ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·he·‘ĕ·ḇî·rū ṯa·‘ar ‘al- kāl- bə·śā·rām wə·ḵib·bə·sū ḇiḡ·ḏê·hem wə·hiṭ·ṭe·hā·rū
verses.literal: This is what you must do to cleanse them Sprinkle them with the water of purification Have them shave . . . . . . their whole bodies and wash their clothes and so purify themselves

verses.original: וְלָֽקְחוּ֙ פַּ֣ר בֶּן־ בָּקָ֔ר וּמִנְחָת֔וֹ סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן תִּקַּ֥ח שֵׁנִ֥י בֶן־ בָּקָ֖ר וּפַר־ לְחַטָּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qə·ḥū par ben- bā·qār ū·min·ḥā·ṯōw sō·leṯ bə·lū·lāh ḇaš·šā·men tiq·qaḥ šê·nî ḇen- bā·qār ū·p̄ar- lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ
verses.literal: Then have them take a young bull . . . . . . with its grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil and you are to take a second . . . . . . young bull for a sin offering

verses.original: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ֙ אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְהִ֨קְהַלְתָּ֔ אֶֽת־ כָּל־ עֲדַ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·raḇ·tā ’eṯ- hal·wî·yim lip̄·nê ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ wə·hiq·hal·tā ’eṯ- kāl- ‘ă·ḏaṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Bring - the Levites before the Tent of Meeting and assemble - the whole congregation . . . of Israel

verses.original: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ֥ אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֖ם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה בְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת־ וְסָמְכ֧וּ יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־ הַלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·raḇ·tā ’eṯ- hal·wî·yim lip̄·nê Yah·weh ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- wə·sā·mə·ḵū yə·ḏê·hem ‘al- hal·wî·yim
verses.literal: You are to present - the Levites before the LORD and have the Israelites . . . - lay their hands upon [them]

verses.original: אַהֲרֹ֨ן אֶת־ וְהֵנִיף֩ הַלְוִיִּ֤ם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה מֵאֵ֖ת תְּנוּפָה֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהָי֕וּ לַעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־ עֲבֹדַ֥ת יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·hă·rōn ’eṯ- wə·hê·nîp̄ hal·wî·yim lip̄·nê Yah·weh mê·’êṯ tə·nū·p̄āh bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·hā·yū la·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’eṯ- ‘ă·ḇō·ḏaṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Aaron - is to present the Levites before the LORD . . . as a wave offering from the sons of Israel . . . so that they may perform - the service of the LORD

verses.original: וְהַלְוִיִּם֙ יִסְמְכ֣וּ אֶת־ יְדֵיהֶ֔ם עַ֖ל רֹ֣אשׁ הַפָּרִ֑ים וַ֠עֲשֵׂה אֶת־ לַֽיהוָ֔ה הָאֶחָ֨ד חַטָּ֜את וְאֶת־ הָאֶחָ֤ד עֹלָה֙ לְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל־ הַלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hal·wî·yim yis·mə·ḵū ’eṯ- yə·ḏê·hem ‘al rōš hap·pā·rîm wa·‘ă·śêh ’eṯ- Yah·weh hā·’e·ḥāḏ ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·’eṯ- hā·’e·ḥāḏ ‘ō·lāh lə·ḵap·pêr ‘al- hal·wî·yim
verses.literal: And the Levites are to lay - their hands on the heads of the bulls and offer - to the LORD one as a sin offering - and the other as a burnt offering to make atonement for the Levites

verses.original: הַלְוִיִּ֔ם וְהַֽעֲמַדְתָּ֙ אֶת־ לִפְנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְלִפְנֵ֣י בָנָ֑יו וְהֵנַפְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֛ם לַֽיהוָֽה׃ תְּנוּפָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: hal·wî·yim wə·ha·‘ă·maḏ·tā ’eṯ- lip̄·nê ’a·hă·rōn wə·lip̄·nê ḇā·nāw wə·hê·nap̄·tā ’ō·ṯām Yah·weh tə·nū·p̄āh
verses.literal: You are to have the Levites stand - before Aaron . . . and his sons and then present them before the LORD as a wave offering

verses.original: וְהִבְדַּלְתָּ֙ אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם מִתּ֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הַלְוִיִּֽם׃ וְהָ֥יוּ לִ֖י
verses.transliteration: wə·hiḇ·dal·tā ’eṯ- hal·wî·yim mit·tō·wḵ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl hal·wî·yim wə·hā·yū lî
verses.literal: In this way you shall separate - the Levites from vvv the rest of the Israelites and the Levites will belong to Me

verses.original: וְאַֽחֲרֵי־ כֵן֙ וְטִֽהַרְתָּ֣ אֹתָ֔ם וְהֵנַפְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם תְּנוּפָֽה׃ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם יָבֹ֣אוּ לַעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên wə·ṭi·har·tā ’ō·ṯām wə·hê·nap̄·tā ’ō·ṯām tə·nū·p̄āh hal·wî·yim yā·ḇō·’ū la·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’eṯ- ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: After - you have cleansed them and presented them as a wave offering [they] may come to serve - at the Tent of Meeting

verses.original: כִּי֩ הֵ֙מָּה֙ נְתֻנִ֨ים נְתֻנִ֥ים לִ֔י מִתּ֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לָקַ֥חְתִּי אֹתָ֖ם לִֽי׃ תַּחַת֩ כָּל־ פִּטְרַ֨ת רֶ֜חֶם בְּכ֥וֹר כֹּל֙ מִבְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
verses.transliteration: kî hêm·māh nə·ṯu·nîm nə·ṯu·nîm lî mit·tō·wḵ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lā·qaḥ·tî ’ō·ṯām lî ta·ḥaṯ kāl- piṭ·raṯ re·ḥem bə·ḵō·wr kōl mib·bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: For [the Levites] have been wholly given . . . to Me from among the sons of Israel I have taken them for Myself in place of all who come first from the womb the firstborn of all the sons of Israel

verses.original: כִּ֣י כָל־ בְּכוֹר֙ בִּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לִ֤י בָּאָדָ֖ם וּבַבְּהֵמָ֑ה הִקְדַּ֥שְׁתִּי אֹתָ֖ם לִֽי׃ בְּי֗וֹם הַכֹּתִ֤י כָל־ בְּכוֹר֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם
verses.transliteration: kî ḵāl bə·ḵō·wr biḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl lî bā·’ā·ḏām ū·ḇab·bə·hê·māh hiq·daš·tî ’ō·ṯām lî bə·yō·wm hak·kō·ṯî ḵāl bə·ḵō·wr bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim
verses.literal: For every firstborn male in Israel is Mine both man and beast I set them apart - for Myself on the day I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt

verses.original: וָאֶקַּח֙ אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם תַּ֥חַת כָּל־ בְּכ֖וֹר בִּבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eq·qaḥ ’eṯ- hal·wî·yim ta·ḥaṯ kāl- bə·ḵō·wr biḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: But I have taken - the Levites in place of all the firstborn among the sons of Israel

verses.original: וָאֶתְּנָ֨ה אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֜ם נְתֻנִ֣ים׀ לְאַהֲרֹ֣ן בְּנֵ֣י מִתּוֹךְ֮ וּלְבָנָ֗יו יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ לַעֲבֹ֞ד אֶת־ עֲבֹדַ֤ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וּלְכַפֵּ֖ר בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עַל־ וְלֹ֨א נֶ֔גֶף יִהְיֶ֜ה בִּבְנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל־ בְּגֶ֥שֶׁת הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’et·tə·nāh ’eṯ- hal·wî·yim nə·ṯu·nîm lə·’a·hă·rōn bə·nê mit·tō·wḵ ū·lə·ḇā·nāw yiś·rā·’êl la·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’eṯ- ‘ă·ḇō·ḏaṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl bə·’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ ū·lə·ḵap·pêr bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ‘al- wə·lō ne·ḡep̄ yih·yeh biḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’el- bə·ḡe·šeṯ haq·qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron [and] his sons from among vvv the Israelites to perform - the service for the Israelites . . . at the Tent of Meeting and to make atonement on their . . . behalf so that no plague will come against the Israelites . . . when they . . . . . . approach the sanctuary

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֧ה וְאַהֲרֹ֛ן וְכָל־ עֲדַ֥ת בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַיַּ֨עַשׂ לַלְוִיִּ֑ם כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֤ה אֶת־ צִוָּ֨ה מֹשֶׁה֙ כֵּן־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ עָשׂ֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם לַלְוִיִּ֔ם
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn wə·ḵāl ‘ă·ḏaṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl way·ya·‘aś lal·wî·yim kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- Yah·weh ’eṯ- ṣiw·wāh mō·šeh kên- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ‘ā·śū lā·hem lal·wî·yim
verses.literal: So Moses Aaron and the whole congregation . . . of Israel did with the Levites everything that the LORD - had commanded Moses . . . [they] . . . should do - -

verses.original: הַלְוִיִּ֗ם וַיִּֽתְחַטְּא֣וּ וַֽיְכַבְּסוּ֙ בִּגְדֵיהֶ֔ם אַהֲרֹ֥ן וַיָּ֨נֶף אֹתָ֛ם תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אַהֲרֹ֖ן וַיְכַפֵּ֧ר עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם לְטַהֲרָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hal·wî·yim way·yiṯ·ḥaṭ·ṭə·’ū way·ḵab·bə·sū biḡ·ḏê·hem ’a·hă·rōn way·yā·nep̄ ’ō·ṯām tə·nū·p̄āh lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’a·hă·rōn way·ḵap·pêr ‘ă·lê·hem lə·ṭa·hă·rām
verses.literal: The Levites purified themselves and washed their clothes and Aaron presented them as a wave offering before the LORD Aaron also made atonement for them to cleanse them

verses.original: וְאַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֞ן הַלְוִיִּ֗ם בָּ֣אוּ לַעֲבֹ֤ד אֶת־ עֲבֹֽדָתָם֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד לִפְנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְלִפְנֵ֣י בָנָ֑יו כֵּ֖ן עָשׂ֥וּ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם לָהֶֽם׃ס כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ יְהוָ֤ה אֶת־ צִוָּ֨ה מֹשֶׁה֙ עַל־
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên hal·wî·yim bā·’ū la·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’eṯ- ‘ă·ḇō·ḏā·ṯām bə·’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ lip̄·nê ’a·hă·rōn wə·lip̄·nê ḇā·nāw kên ‘ā·śū hal·wî·yim lā·hem ka·’ă·šer Yah·weh ’eṯ- ṣiw·wāh mō·šeh ‘al-
verses.literal: After that the Levites came to perform their service at the Tent of Meeting in the presence of Aaron . . . and his sons Thus they did with the Levites just as the LORD - had commanded Moses -

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Moses -

verses.original: זֹ֖את אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַלְוִיִּ֑ם חָמֵ֨שׁ וְעֶשְׂרִ֤ים מִבֶּן֩ שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה יָבוֹא֙ לִצְבֹ֣א צָבָ֔א בַּעֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: zōṯ ’ă·šer lal·wî·yim ḥā·mêš wə·‘eś·rîm mib·ben šā·nāh wā·ma‘·lāh yā·ḇō·w liṣ·ḇō ṣā·ḇā ba·‘ă·ḇō·ḏaṯ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: This applies to the Levites Men twenty-five . . . years of age . . . or older shall enter to perform the service in the work at the Tent of Meeting

verses.original: וּמִבֶּן֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה יָשׁ֖וּב מִצְּבָ֣א הָעֲבֹדָ֑ה וְלֹ֥א עֽוֹד׃ יַעֲבֹ֖ד
verses.transliteration: ū·mib·ben ḥă·miš·šîm šā·nāh yā·šūḇ miṣ·ṣə·ḇā hā·‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh wə·lō ‘ō·wḏ ya·‘ă·ḇōḏ
verses.literal: But at the age of fifty . . . they must retire from performing the work and no longer serve

verses.original: וְשֵׁרֵ֨ת אֶת־ אֶחָ֜יו לִשְׁמֹ֣ר מִשְׁמֶ֔רֶת בְּאֹ֤הֶל מוֹעֵד֙ לֹ֣א יַעֲבֹ֑ד וַעֲבֹדָ֖ה כָּ֛כָה תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה בְּמִשְׁמְרֹתָֽם׃פ לַלְוִיִּ֖ם
verses.transliteration: wə·šê·rêṯ ’eṯ- ’e·ḥāw liš·mōr miš·me·reṯ bə·’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ lō ya·‘ă·ḇōḏ wa·‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh kā·ḵāh ta·‘ă·śeh bə·miš·mə·rō·ṯām lal·wî·yim
verses.literal: After that, they may assist - their brothers in fulfilling their duties at the Tent of Meeting but they themselves are not to do the work This is how you are to assign responsibilities to the Levites
